about.title: About Dday
about.description: A fictional admin panel built to practice Angular and management interfaces: payments, employees, departments and liquidity.

highlights.standalone: Angular 15 with standalone components and lazy routes
highlights.rxjs: Reactive state with RxJS (BehaviorSubject, combineLatest, switchMap)
highlights.forms: Typed reactive forms with async validation
highlights.i18n: Portuguese and English interface with ngx-translate
highlights.a11y: Keyboard navigation, managed focus and ARIA attributes
highlights.backend: Simulated backend with HttpInterceptor: REST routes, latency, HTTP status codes and failures

about.data-notice: There is no server: an HttpInterceptor answers /api calls with fictional in-memory data and simulated latency. Changes are reset when the page reloads.
about.simulate-failures-hint: 30% of requests will fail, so you can see the error states and the automatic retry.
